releaseNotes:
First launch asks you to accept the terms, privacy notice, and system-change warning
Auto Tweak lists the games installed on your PC, creates a restore point, then optimizes that game and safe PC settings
Pro features stay locked until your license is activated
Quick tweaks now live in PC Booster
The sidebar scrolls so every section, including Deep Debloat, is reachable
Section titles sit directly above their descriptions
The app icon is the WinTweak W
Closing the window fully exits the app
Discord linking works through the official site
